chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-Khazzāz, from Ghiyāth ibn Ibrāhīm, from Jaʿfar, from his father, peace be upon them.
“That ʿAlī, peace be upon him, ruled concerning
a man who was struck until his urine became uncontrolled, that there is a full diyah.”

key_terms.سَلِسَ: became afflicted with incontinence or continual flow

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone is injured until he loses control of his urination?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a judicial ruling from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding bodily injury. It states that if a man is beaten to the point that he loses control of his urination, the compensation due is the full diyah, showing the gravity of permanent bodily harm in Islamic law.
